name: BlazBlue EX: shared presentation
author: BBEE Redux
description: Shared BlazBlue EX presentation (actor ids 190000-199999): the EX page on character select (press Down), the purple EX card and name (solo and local co-op), the base character's voice where an EX cue is missing, and the intro-movie button disabled for EX.
